topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I walked through the park, each step feeling heavier than the last. The leaves rustled softly, but my thoughts were louder. I saw them from afar, and for a moment, the world paused. I waved, and as they turned, their face didn’t light up the way I hoped. The smile was polite, distant. “Hey,” I managed, my voice catching a little. “Long time, right?” We chatted about this and that, but the conversation felt off, like trying to piece together a puzzle with missing pieces. I kept dropping hints, reminders of our past, but their eyes stayed blank, the spark I remembered nowhere to be found. I left feeling like I was walking through the remnants of a dream, wondering where the pieces of my past had gone.
